goal: C++ review: memory ownership, bounds, undefined behaviour and exception safety.
use: C++ review: memory ownership, bounds, undefined behaviour and exception safety. Use when asked to review a C++ project or module.

steps.note: Read the project setup. Build files, the standard in use and sanitiser settings.
Check ownership. Flag raw new and delete without a clear owner.
Check bounds. Flag indexing and copies with no size check.
Check undefined behaviour. Flag signed overflow, uninitialised values and dangling references.
Report. Each finding with file and line, severity and the fix.
